detail.notInstalled: Palibe kopi yoyikidwa yomwe yapezeka, ndipo palibe vuto: decoy siikufunika imodzi.
detail.noteDone: Mutha kuyimitsa tsopano, ntchito iyenera kuwerengedwa.
detail.noteRunning: Ndondomekoyi ikuyenda kumbuyo. Mutha kuchepetsa zenera kupita ku thireyi.
detail.noExe.title: Discord sidziwabe exe ya masewerawa
detail.noExe.text: Sizingatheke kuzindikirika kudzera mu ndondomeko. Dinani “Sinthani nkhokwe ya deta” pambuyo pake: Discord ikangowonjezera exe, masewerawa apezeka.
running.title: Zikuyenda
running.empty.title: Palibe chomwe chikuyenda
running.empty.text: Tsegulani masewera mu laibulale ndikudina “Yambitsani decoy”.
settings.title: Zokonda
settings.language.desc: Chilankhulo cha mawonekedwe. Zilankhulo zatsopano zimawonjezedwa ngati mafayilo mufoda ya locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Ndi mphindi zingati zosungira ndondomeko. Zokhazikika ndi 16, osati 15: mafunso a Discord amafuna mphindi 15 zosewerera, koma Discord imafunika mpaka mphindi imodzi kuti izindikire masewera atsopano.
settings.smartTimer.desc: Kuwerengera kumayamba pamene Discord yazindikira decoy, osati pamene mukuiyambitsa. Kuti idziwe zimenezi, pulogalamuyi imawerenga mizere yokhudza masewera omwe akuyenda kuchokera mu chipika chapafupi cha Discord; palibe chomwe chimasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa kulikonse.
settings.autoUpdate.desc: Onani GitHub poyambitsa komanso pakapita maola 6 aliwonse ndipo koperani mitundu yatsopano kumbuyo. Kukhazikitsa kumadikirira nthawi zonse chitsimikizo chanu, ndipo mafayilo amatsimikiziridwa ndi siginecha yawo ya digito.
detail.waitingNote: Discord imafunika mpaka mphindi imodzi kuti izindikire masewera. Kuwerengera kumayamba ikawona decoy.
settings.tray.desc: Ma decoy amapitiriza kugwira ntchito pulogalamuyi ikakhala mu thireyi.
settings.source.desc: Mndandanda wapadera wa Discord · masewera {n} · zasinthidwa {date}
settings.showNoExe.desc: Zolowa zomwe Discord sidzidziwa ndondomeko yake (sizingathe kuyambitsidwa).
settings.dataDir.desc: Komwe mndandanda wamasewera ndi zokonda zimasungidwa.
settings.dataDir.portable: Mawonekedwe a portable: chilichonse chimasungidwa pafupi ndi decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy siigwiritsa ntchito tokeni yanu ya Discord ndipo silandira ma quest m'malo mwanu. Kutengera ndondomeko ya masewera kungakhale kusemphana ndi malamulo a Discord, gwiritsani ntchito mwakufuna kwanu.
toast.launched: “{name}” yayambitsidwa kwa mphindi {n}. Discord iyenera kuzindikira pakadutsa pafupifupi masekondi 15.
toast.refreshUpToDate: Nkhokwe ya deta ndi yatsopano kale
lab.title: Labu
lab.subtitle: Tabu yachinsinsi: imayambitsa ma decoy ambiri nthawi imodzi.
lab.count.desc: Masewera amasankhidwa mwachisawawa, omwe akuyenda kale amadumphedwa. Iliyonse imayenda kwa mphindi {n} (yokhazikitsidwa mu Zokonda).
lab.warn: Decoy iliyonse ndi ndondomeko yosiyana yokhala ndi zenera. Zochulukirapo nthawi imodzi zitha kuimitsa kompyuta yanu: ndondomeko iliyonse ndi zenera zimagwiritsa ntchito kukumbukira, ndipo pambuyo pa mawindo masauzande owerengeka Windows ikhoza kusiya kupanga ena. Mukatseka Decoy, ma decoy onse amaima.
lab.risk.mid: Kuyambira pafupifupi ma decoy 250 kupita m'tsogolo, Discord yokha imatha kuchedwa: imatsata masewera aliwonse omwe akuyenda ndikuwapereka ku ma seva ake.
lab.risk.high: Kuopsa: ma decoy 5,000 atayambitsidwa nthawi imodzi, Discord idakula kupitilira 10 GB ya RAM ndipo imawonongeka masekondi 30 aliwonse mpaka deta yake yomwe ili pamakina itasinthidwanso. Decoy imayimitsa chilichonse ngati kukumbukira kwa Discord kudumpha, koma palibe chitsimikizo.
lab.discordRam: Discord ikugwiritsa ntchito {gb} GB ya RAM pakadali pano.
lab.unlock.desc: Pamwamba pa malirewa Discord yasweka muzochita. Yatsani pokhapokha mutamvetsetsa chiwopsezo.
guard.tripped: Ma decoy onse ayimitsidwa pofuna kuteteza Discord: ikugwiritsa ntchito {gb} GB ya RAM (yakwera ndi {grew} GB). Ngati ikuchedwa, yambitsaninso.
lab.next: Masewera amapita motsatira zilembo. Gulu lotsatira limayamba ndi “{name}”.
lab.estimate: Ma decoy {n} adzagwiritsa ntchito pafupifupi {ram} ya RAM.
lab.limit: Windows idasiya kuyambitsa njira zatsopano pambuyo pa {n}: umenewo ndi malire a dongosolo.
